description: Dear Neighbor,I have known Bill Muto for more than twenty years. We met the way most people around here meet, on a playing field, with a bag of equipment and a roster full of kids who needed somewhere to be.We coached together, and I watched how he handled every child on that team. Any coach can work with the kids who already know how to play. What I noticed about Bill was how he worked with the ones who did not. He never let a child fade into the background.
